name: Editor for SQL database in Fabric
description: The SQL query editor in the Microsoft Fabric portal is a powerful tool designed for writing and executing T-SQL queries. Here are its key features:* IntelliSense and Code Completion: Provides support for syntax highlighting, client-side parsing, and validation.* Query Execution: Allows running Data Definition Language (DDL), Data Manipulation Language (DML), and Data Control Language (DCL) statements.* Automatic Saving: Queries are saved automatically every few seconds.* Result Viewing: Displays query results in a grid, with options to search within results and download them in various formats (Excel, JSON, CSV).* Copilot Integration: Utilizes AI to assist in writing and managing queries, enhancing efficiency.* Keyboard Shortcuts: Offers various shortcuts to streamline query writing and execution.
